THE WRITING DESK

A new field note.

Write, preview, and export a post. Drafts stay in this browser when local storage is available. Exported files can be added to the website’s article collection and published with the next site update.

Export creates a draft Markdown file. Nothing is published from this page. To publish, add the file to content/posts, set draft: false, then rebuild and deploy the site—or attach it in this chat and ask me to publish it.
